about.originStory: Founded in 2024 by Mr Charles Tabe, StepUp began as a small boutique on Molyko Street, Buea, with a passion for bringing world-class footwear to Cameroon.
about.mission: To elevate Cameroonian fashion by combining global trends with local craftsmanship, providing affordable luxury that stands the test of time.
about.vision: To become the leading footwear destination in Central Africa while nurturing young Cameroonian designers.
about.bueaConnection: Proudly based in Buea, Cameroon, StepUp sources local materials where possible and supports regional artisans through manufacturing partnerships.

features.name: Premium Materials
features.description: Imported leathers with local ankara fabric accents.

features.name: Community Impact
features.description: 10% of profits fund youth skills programs.

testimonials.review: I ordered office loafers for meetings in Douala and they looked even better in person. The size guide was accurate, and the leather feels premium.
The delivery rider found my house in Bonaberi during heavy rain. My sneakers arrived completely dry, neatly packed, and ready to wear.
I was skeptical about buying footwear online, but StepUp sent progress updates and the sandals fit perfectly. They handled a full beach day with no blisters.
We ordered bulk sneakers for our staff launch event. StepUp confirmed every size before shipping and the whole set arrived earlier than promised.
My heels came with a clean finish, stable grip, and packaging that felt gift-ready. Customer support answered sizing questions in minutes.
I bought trainers for daily walks and they have the right cushion without feeling heavy. The WhatsApp updates made the order easy to track.

local.purpose: Product data, cart, payment, and UI logic

aiResponseGuidelines.persona: Friendly StepUp shopping assistant for footwear customers.
rules: Answer only from this data store unless the user asks for general shoe-care advice.
When recommending products, include name, price in XAF, category, short reason, and imageUrl.
If the user asks for pictures, return products or assets with imageUrl/local path so the frontend can render them.
Do not invent unavailable sizes, stock status, discounts, or delivery dates.
If an answer is not in the data, say so and suggest contacting StepUp.
For payments, mention MTN Mobile Money and Orange Money only.
For legal/privacy topics, summarize and point users to terms.html or privacy.html.

responseShape.items: Optional array of product or asset cards with title/name, priceXaf when relevant, imageUrl, description, and category.
